name: maybe_Gfx_Pica_WriteTextureStatePacket
signature: u32* maybe_Gfx_Pica_WriteTextureStatePacket(char* enable, u32* cmdBuf, int append, int extended)
summary: Writes a PICA200 texture-environment command packet (header 0x00E40103, registers 0x8B/0x130) into a command buffer, converting float colors to fixed point.
evidence: Body emits PICA200 register command words 0x00E40103, 0x000F008B, 0x000F0130 and packs floats; but r12 context is unrecovered and the only caller is Event_ClearActorSlots, which does not fit a texture writer, so the class stays uncertain.

name: maybe_Sound_SeqPlayer_InitFromHandle
summary: Looks up a sound sequence player by handle and initializes its playback state fields (+0x18..+0x29).
evidence: Damaged decompilation with in_ZR condition flag; calls func_00556C48(handle+8) and writes default playback fields, but the guard is unrecovered so the name stays tentative.

name: maybe_Actor_IsHandleFree
summary: Returns 1 when the actor's reference at +4 is null or the slot is reported unused by 0x00643744.
evidence: Explicit u32 predicate return; calls maybe_Actor_IsHandleSlotUnused; only caller is SpiritMessage, so the actor class is plausible but not proven.

name: maybe_Ui_Part_IsVisibleOrForced
summary: Three-way visibility gate: true when the index at +0x28 is non-negative, or the owner at +0x24 is set and its float at +0x148 is non-zero, or the force byte at +0x2C is set.
evidence: No direct caller at the exact address (the listed callers belong to merged accessors); class and 'visible' wording remain unproven.

name: maybe_Ui_Object_NotifyChild
summary: Two-step virtual forwarder: calls self->vtbl[+0x70](self) then tail-calls slot 2 (+0x08) on the returned object.
evidence: No caller and not a slot in any rodata table; direction (owner vs child) unproven.

name: maybe_Actor_IsHandleSlotUnused
summary: Slot-unused test: true only when the pointer at +0x1F60 is null, the reference at +0x144 is null and bit 0 of +0x148 is clear.
evidence: Three zero-tests confirmed by disassembly of the callee; only caller is maybe_Actor_IsHandleFree, so the actor class is plausible but not proven.

name: maybe_Field_FindObjectInListA
signature: u32 maybe_Field_FindObjectInListA(FieldList* self, u32* out, int slot, u32 key, u8 mask)
summary: Walks the intrusive list at self+0x18 and returns the first entry whose +0xF8 flag intersects mask and whose per-slot key at entry+slot*0xC+0x20 matches key, writing the match and owner bytes into out.
evidence: No caller; list owner and out[] layout unknown, though the list-walk and key-match shape is clear.

name: maybe_Field_FindObjectInListB
signature: u32 maybe_Field_FindObjectInListB(FieldList* self, u8* out, u32 key, u8 mask)
summary: Variant of 0x00643FE4 over the same intrusive list, matching on the entry's own field at +0x10 and writing the entry type byte (+0x1C) plus owner bytes into out.
evidence: No caller; near-copy of 0x00643FE4 with key from entry+0x10, confirming the A/B pairing but not the list owner.

name: maybe_Object_IsNestedCounterBehind
summary: Compares two counters reached through a pointer chain (obj+0x160 -> +0x568 -> +0x34 vs +0x56C) and returns whether the first is <= the second; the callee is a merged blob so the exact semantics stay unclear.
evidence: Only callee is 0x00669DD4, a mid-entry of a merged blob; no callers; the doc's counter comparison is inferred from disassembly of that blob, not from this body.

name: maybe_Data_LookupIndexById
summary: Lazily builds the 0x10-byte-entry data-manager table and returns the byte at +0x10 of the record found by 0x0063E3C8 for the given id, or 0xFF when unknown.
evidence: Body clearly constructs a vtable'd container (Container_ResizeArray, Container_GetPooledEntryThunk) and does a 0x0063E3C8 lookup returning f_10 or 0xFF; callers are unnamed UI functions so the record type is unknown.

name: maybe_PartyMember_GetSpellRecordFlag
summary: Calls virtual slot +0x64, and if the result's byte +0x10 is zero returns bit 0 of the u16 flag word at +0x208 of the record pointed to by self+0x1260.
evidence: +0x208 matches the documented SpellRecord flag word, but there are no callers and the +0x1260 pointer and class are unverified.

name: maybe_Ui_GetScaledTime
summary: Merged blob of many small accessors; only a surviving fragment calls 0x0065D3B8 for a tick value and converts it with VectorUnsignedToFloat using FPSCR rounding bits.
evidence: 1272-byte span with many merged sub-symbols; the 19 callers belong to those small accessors, not to this address; no exact-address caller.

name: Battle_CanUnitAct
summary: Action-eligibility gate: resolves two ids through 0x0022C148/0x0022F59C, reads the resulting unit state byte (0xFF when absent) and allows only states 1/2, or 3/0x17 when the first id is empty.
evidence: State getter 0x00669250 returns a unit state byte with 0xFF default; callers include Ui_SakusenWindow_* (battle command window) and Field_Actor_UpdateCellTransition, consistent with an action-eligibility check.

name: maybe_Field_GetSceneState
summary: Returns 3 when the probe 0x006281C8 reports a live scene, otherwise 0; most of the 0xBC-byte span is lost in decompilation.
evidence: Only a two-branch constant return around one unnamed probe survives; single caller Field_FindObjectByMode and callee Battle_Unit_SelectMimicEndCommand give no clear semantics.

name: Ui_SmithMenu_GetRowState
summary: Row-state accessor: for mode byte +0x50 == 2 returns the item object's byte at +0x50, for mode 3 the word at item+0x64, and 5 otherwise; 0 when the item pointer at +0x54 is null.
evidence: Address is a slot in the rodata table 0x0076E7C4 whose neighbours are named Ui_SmithMenu_CommitRow, Ui_SmithMenu_SubObject_Ctor etc.; callers are Ui_SmithMenu_HandleCommand/SelectRow/CommitRow.

name: maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_IsRecipeRow
summary: Row predicate: false when the sub-object at +0x14 reports state 1, the index at +0xC0 is valid and the 8-byte record it selects has an id other than the 0x306 sentinel; otherwise true only when the row's virtual +0x54 reports ready.
evidence: No callers; address is a slot in the UI widget table 0x007808E0 with Ui_Widget_* neighbours, supporting a UI row predicate but not the 'recipe' wording.

name: maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_AllSlotsIdle
summary: Checks a row's two slot windows, its registered handle and its ready virtual; no caller found and the vtable neighbours are generic UI widget methods, so the smith-menu attribution is unproven.
evidence: No callers; slot in UI widget table 0x00780A4C next to Ui_DrawList_InsertWindowNodes and Ui_Screen_IsAnyChildBusy; body is a generic idle/handle-validity predicate.

name: maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_IsMaterialValid
summary: Same validity test as 0x0064D824 but through row+0x274: returns 0 when the sub-object reports state 1, has a valid index and a record id other than the 0x306 sentinel.
evidence: Body mirrors 0x0064D824 with row+0x274; only caller is maybe_Field_Object2D_AdvanceTouchTransition, so the smith-menu context is not confirmed.

name: Battle_UnitModel_AreSubSlotsIdle
summary: Returns 1 when the busy byte at +0xB0 is clear and all four sub-objects at +0x118..+0x124 are null or idle via virtual +0x7C.
evidence: Appears as a slot in four rodata tables whose neighbours are all Battle_UnitModel methods (MoveBy, SetAlpha, SetPosition, AssignHandleA/B, FinishTween).

name: maybe_Actor_IsHandleAliveD
summary: Template copy of the actor slot test: true when the owner/reference chain is null and the actor's reference at +4 is null with bit 0 of +8 clear.
evidence: Same three-condition shape as 0x00643744 anchored on actor+0x34 -> +0x1E18; 15 callers are UI equipment/message-voice code, so the exact semantics remain unclear.

name: maybe_Ui_List_GetScrollRowIndex
summary: Computes an absolute row index from the list's scroll state and resolves it through 0x00650860/0x00648348, returning 0xFFFFFFFF when the row array at +0x54 is null.
evidence: Index expression matches Ui_SmithMenu_GetCellIndex (0x0064D59C); callers include Ui_ListWidget_GetCursorValue and several list windows, consistent with a shared list-row lookup.

name: maybe_Battle_Unit_QueryStatusPair
signature: void maybe_Battle_Unit_QueryStatusPair(Actor* self, BattleUnit* unit, u8* outFlagA, u8* outFlagB)
summary: Fills two status flags for a unit: (0,0) while busy or unresolved, otherwise maps monster state 6 to (1,0) and 7 to (0,1).
evidence: No callers; body readable but the two output flags are never observed consumed, and the state mapping is only partially clear.

name: maybe_Field_QueryFourBoxes
signature: void maybe_Field_QueryFourBoxes(QueryOwner* owner, int scene, int layer, int* rect, int* grow, int* grow2, u8* results)
summary: Calls the owner's scene query callback four times with successively grown rectangles and stores the four boolean results.
evidence: Three callers are all placement/overlap tests (maybe_Field_TestAreaOverlapA/B, maybe_Field_ComputeGridMoveDelta), supporting a four-box placement query; all callers are themselves maybe_ names.

name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_GetRowFlag
summary: Returns the flag byte of the row under the cursor: index = (cursorTarget->f_C * 10 + rowIndex) - firstVisibleRow(vtable+0x68), read from 10-byte rows at self+0x78.
evidence: 10-byte row stride at +0x78 and vtable+0x68 first-visible-row helper match Ui_ListWindow_UpdateScroll layout; callers split between tactics window and casino slot init, so the exact row semantics stay uncertain.

name: maybe_Pack_WriteWordQuadAt60
summary: Writes four u32 words at self+0x60..0x6C through writer->vtbl[+0x10]; no caller or table reference identifies the record or writer class.
evidence: Clean four-iteration loop with virtual writer call; zero callers, no rodata xref, no vtable neighbours.

name: maybe_Pack_WriteWordQuadAt50
summary: Twin of 0x00654DA4 writing the four words at self+0x50..0x5C; same unknown record/writer classes.
evidence: Body identical to 0x00654DA4 except base offset 0x50; no callers.

name: maybe_Field_TryPlayerInteractGated
summary: ANDs the global player-ready predicate with the grid interaction query; the only caller is itself a maybe_ battle-item check, so the gate's owner is unclear.
evidence: Two-call AND body; caller 0x0063469C maybe_Battle_CanUseItemOnSelf, callee maybe_Field_CheckGridInteraction.

name: maybe_Effect_ActorTrail_LiteralPool
summary: Not a function: literal-pool data misdecoded as Thumb, body is halt_baddata().
evidence: halt_baddata() with bad-instruction warning; no real callers, only a spurious xref from Effect_ActorTrail_ShouldFinishB.

name: maybe_Pack_ReadInline6A
signature: bool maybe_Pack_ReadInline6A(void* dst, u32 arg2, u32* outSize, u32 avail)
summary: Interior switch case: copies six bytes from the record pointer in r12+4 to dst and reports 6 when avail>=6.
evidence: Damaged decompilation (in_r12 carries record pointer); no callers; expected for an interior case entry.

name: maybe_Pack_ReadLengthPrefixedRecord
signature: bool maybe_Pack_ReadLengthPrefixedRecord(InlineRecord* record, void* dst, u32* outSize, u32* avail)
summary: Copies a five-byte inline header from record+5 then the payload at record+0xC of length u16 at record+8, reporting 5+length.
evidence: Body intact, 5 + u16-at-+8 layout clear, but no callers and record class unknown.

name: maybe_Pack_ReadInline6B
signature: bool maybe_Pack_ReadInline6B(void* dst, u32 arg2, u32* outSize, u32 avail)
summary: Second six-byte inline reader, byte-identical to 0x006583E8; same damaged in_r12 shape.
evidence: Identical body to 0x006583E8; no callers; damaged decompilation.

name: maybe_Pack_ReadInline3
signature: bool maybe_Pack_ReadInline3(void* dst, u32 arg2, u32* outSize, u32 avail)
summary: Three-byte inline reader copying from r12+4 to dst and reporting 3; same damaged shape as the six-byte variants.
evidence: Same in_r12 pattern, only length differs; no callers.

name: maybe_Svc_Cecd_Command12
signature: u32 maybe_Svc_Cecd_Command12(CecdSession* self, void* buffer, u32 size)
summary: Zeroes a 0x60-byte buffer and issues command 0x12 through the session virtual at +0x34, returning 0xC8810BEF when nothing was written; the command's meaning is undocumented.
evidence: Body shows command 0x12, 0x60 buffer, 0xC8810BEF error; no callers and no CECD command table in project, so the specific command stays unknown.

name: maybe_Svc_Blob_SerializeTail
signature: bool maybe_Svc_Blob_SerializeTail(u32 arg1, u32 value, u32* other, u32 src)
summary: Continuation entry that compares an 8-byte block at src via 0x001009DC and returns true on match; the in_ZR test depends on caller flags, so it is not a standalone function.
evidence: Damaged decompilation (in_ZR) and no direct caller; only a tail reference from Fs_Archive_ResolvePath, so the purpose cannot be pinned down.

name: Svc_Blob_FindRecordByName
summary: Linear search over the record array at self+0x18 comparing each record's name string against name, returning the index or -1.
evidence: Clean linear search with a string compare (0x0010540C) over count at indexHeader+8 and name pool at self->f_10; the only xref is a misattributed tail jump from a neighbouring function.

name: Sound_SeqPlayer_OnEvent
summary: Chain-of-responsibility event dispatch: offers the event to the child at +0x21C, then to the shared forwarder 0x00660414, and finally to the class virtual +0x10.
evidence: Readable three-step chain with two virtual calls and one named forwarder; caller Sound_StreamPlayer_Setup is consistent with a sound-player event path.

name: maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetPointerValueA
summary: Returns the first word of the sub-table reached from self+0x3C via the +0x34 relative-offset resolver; one of three sibling pointer getters.
evidence: 0x0065FB98 is 'ldr r1,[r0,#0x34]; add r0,r0,r1', so variant A resolves +0x34; no callers, so the word's meaning is unknown.

name: maybe_Sound_SeqField_NotifyChange
summary: Resolves the sequence-field sub-object at self+0x3C and, if non-null, calls the record-kind getter 0x0065FF20 and discards the result; no visible side effect.
evidence: Resolve-then-query pair with no side effect; 0x0065FF20 is a pure tag-to-kind mapping, so 'NotifyChange' is unsupported and no caller exists.

name: Sound_Seq_GetDataRange
signature: u32 maybe_Sound_Seq_GetDataRange(SoundSeqData* self, unsigned int id, unsigned int** out)
summary: Resolves a sequence entry's {pointer, length} range: stores the entry id through out, then by entry kind stores the raw u32 at +8, clears the second word, or reports failure.
evidence: Caller maybe_Sound_SeqParam_GetRangePair ORs the result with an extension virtual and treats it as a range pair, supporting the 'data range' reading.

name: maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetPointerValueB
summary: Returns the first word of the sub-table reached from self+0x3C via the +0x2C relative-offset resolver; sibling of the +0x34 and +0x1C variants.
evidence: 0x0065FBB0 is 'ldr r1,[r0,#0x2c]; add r0,r0,r1', distinct from A (+0x34) and C (+0x1C); no callers, so the word's meaning is unknown.

name: maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetPointerValueC
summary: Resolves the +0x1C sub-table of the sequence data via the relative-offset resolver and returns its first word; no callers, so the meaning of the word is unknown.
evidence: Calls 0x0065F87C Sound_SeqResource_ResolveId; resolver 0x0065FBC8 adds *(u32*)(self+0x1C); no callers to pin semantics.

name: maybe_Sound_Seq_ExecuteChannelCommand_Tail
summary: Damaged mid-function split symbol: ARM switch tail of Sound_Seq_ExecuteChannelCommand misdisassembled as Thumb, producing halt_baddata and unaff_ registers.
evidence: Body is full of unaff_/in_ZR/coprocessor_* and halt_baddata; follows 0x00661974 directly; callees are sound channel helpers.

name: maybe_Anim_Timeline_Advance
summary: Advances a timeline step: when current time reaches the limit, dispatches a type-indexed callback from table 0x007E8120 and returns a scaled float.
evidence: Compares self+0x10 with limit self+8, dispatches through 0x007E8120 by waveform/type index; callers are sound parsers (Sound_Cwav_Open, Sound_WaveInfo_ParseFormat), so context is ambiguous.

name: maybe_Text_BuildCharTransform_Tail
summary: Damaged continuation fragment of Text_BuildCharTransform (0x00663FB8): stores character transform quad registers from unaff_/in_s registers.
evidence: Direct continuation of 0x00663FB8 (ends at 0x006640FE); body only stores unaff_r4/r5/r7 and in_s0..s3; no callers.

name: maybe_Field_Object2D_PushTrailSample
signature: void maybe_Field_Object2D_PushTrailSample(FieldObject2D* self, FieldUnit* unit, TrailHistory** history)
summary: Shifts a 3-entry position/state history down and pushes a new sample derived from unit->f_4C8 for 2D field object movement trails.
evidence: Reads unit->f_4C8, shifts three 12-byte entries and stores new record; calls Field2D_SpriteBlock_UpdateChipRange and 0x00667BE4; no named callers.

name: Field_Object2D_CalcScreenRectA
summary: Computes a 2D field object screen-space bounding rectangle from position at (object+8)->+0x78/+0x7C with a constant 2x2 extent transformed via 0x0031A658.
evidence: 26 callers including Field2D_Actor_CheckCollisionBox, Field2D_MapChip_BuildCollisionMask, Field2D_Scene_RenderTileGrid; reads object+8 position and writes 4-word rect.

name: maybe_Field_Object2D_CalcScreenRectB
summary: Variant B of the 2D field object screen rect calculation, reading coordinates from object+4 instead of object+8.
evidence: Same body shape as 0x00667BE4 but uses (object+4)->+0x78/+0x7C; no callers.

name: maybe_Field2D_Sprite_ChoosePathStep_Tail
summary: Damaged continuation tail of 0x00667EA4 (Field2D_Sprite_ChoosePathStep): switch-branch stores through unaff_r4 misidentified as a separate Thumb function.
evidence: Follows 0x00667EA4 directly (size 0xEA ends at 0x00667F8E); body only stores unaff_r4/arg2/arg4; sole caller is 0x00667EA4.

name: maybe_Field_Object2D_GetAnimField16
summary: Returns the u8 field at +0x16 of the anim sub-object at (self+8)->+0x2B4 for a 2D field object; used by map-chip layer packing.
evidence: Pure one-line getter of u8 at anim+0x16; callers are Field2D_MapChip_PackLayerChipIds and a map-chip walker, but the field's meaning is not established.

name: maybe_Field_Object2D_GetAnimField10
summary: Returns the u16 property at +0x10 of the anim sub-object at (self+8)->+0x2B4 for a 2D field object sprite; called from the sprite node draw dispatch.
evidence: Pure one-line getter of u16 at anim+0x10; only caller is Field2D_SpriteNode_DispatchDraw, no evidence for the specific field semantics.
